title: omscs-preparation: a dated record of the preparation for an application to Georgia Tech's OMSCS
description:
A dated record of the preparation for an application to the Online Master of Science in Computer Science (OMSCS) of Georgia Tech: the decision of 2026-11-19, the application requirements with their sources, the dates they were read and how far each was confirmed, the courses that the programme recommends, and a progress log. It records what was decided and what was done. It holds no list of tasks to come, and no grades or other personal academic records.

Georgia Tech の OMSCS に出願するための準備を、日付つきで残す記録です。決めたこと、出典と読んだ日と確かめた程度つきの要件、勧められている科目、進み具合の記録を置いています。
